title: Hoffman's DMT research collaboration with Gallimore

tellings.quote: I'm collaborating with Gallamore on on DMT

plain: The scientist Donald Hoffman, who argues that our brains evolved to hide much of reality from us, says he is now working on research into DMT, a powerful psychedelic drug. He tells Michels so himself in 2026: "I'm collaborating with Gallamore on on DMT," naming a researcher called Gallimore. For Hoffman, the drug may be a way to glimpse whatever lies beyond what we normally see.
